name: LINE人事－下班條全流程試跑

parameters.text:
You are classifying and reading a Taiwanese restaurant handwritten work shift / attendance sheet. Return valid JSON ONLY, with no markdown, code fences, or prose.

Use exactly this structure:
{
  "is_attendance_sheet": boolean,
  "header_sequence": string[],
  "date": string | null,
  "employees": [
    {
      "name": string | null,
      "shifts": [{"start": string | null, "end": string | null}],
      "off_or_unclear": boolean,
      "needs_review": boolean,
      "review_reason": string | null
    }
  ],
  "warnings": string[],
  "confidence": number
}

Mandatory classification gate:
1. Set is_attendance_sheet=true ONLY when one visible printed table header row contains four consecutive work-time labels in this exact order: 上班, 下班, 上班, 下班.
2. Copy those four visible labels verbatim into header_sequence. Do not infer them from handwritten times, employee rows, another document, or the expected template.
3. If any label is missing, unclear, out of order, not consecutive in the same header row, or only inferred, set is_attendance_sheet=false, header_sequence to only the labels actually visible, date=null, employees=[], and stop.
4. A title such as 下班條, a date, names, a grid, or handwritten times is never sufficient without the exact four-label header sequence.

Extraction rules when and only when is_attendance_sheet=true:
1. Read EVERY printed employee row in visual order. Never omit a row because it has a slash, blank times, changed day off, or unclear handwriting.
2. Preserve printed Chinese names exactly. Never substitute a similar-looking character. If a name cannot be read confidently, use null and explain its row/location.
3. A slash, 改休, 休, or blank schedule means shifts=[] and off_or_unclear=true.
4. Convert readable times to 24-hour HH:mm. Examples: 930=>09:30, 15=>15:00, 2030=>20:30, 2145=>21:45.
5. Each pair of columns is one shift. Do not combine split shifts.
6. Set needs_review=true when the name, date, time, or mark is uncertain.
7. Never invent missing values. Use null.
8. confidence must be between 0 and 1.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { to: $('僅處理下班條照片').first().json.event.source.groupId, messages: $json.lineMessages.slice(0, 5).map(text => ({ type: 'text', text })) } }}
